rule: Every money-facing agent output (portfolio health, rebalance, stress, research) MUST carry the SEBI not_investment_advice / advice_disclaimer via a single chokepoint. Portfolio handler:264-292 discarded it (grep=0 matches) while research renders it via formatResearchPack — BLOCKER. Fix: helpers/portfolio-disclaimer.ts on BOTH the deterministic health return AND the LLM-bypass rebalance/stress fallback.

The highest-risk output — rebalance/stress fallback emitting REDUCE/SWITCH/ADD directives (handler:310-357) — must not ship with zero boundary framing. Directive outputs need the disclaimer MORE than passive health reads, not less.

Numbers shown to the user must be deterministically computed, never read from LLM JSON (parseWorkerReturn). Portfolio stress/rebalance numbers (recovery_days_estimate existed only in the prompt template; field shapes the deterministic tools never emit) were LLM-invented — the exact de-hallucination breach PR #1592 closed. Strip LLM-authored staleness/impact; compute in TS.

Every data display must carry {data_as_of, is_stale}; default is_stale=TRUE on unknown (deriveStaleness, STALE_AFTER_DAYS=5). 'Data without an as-of is a UX bug' and a compliance gap on money-facing surfaces — a user cannot interpret trading data without temporal context.

Never coerce a missing/stale price to 0 or fall back to a guessed value (holdingValue||0, 0.75% expense-ratio guess, substring 'direct' for plan). Fail-loud GREY on unknown, not 0/GREEN — a synthetic BUY/SWITCH needs live price/sector/expense/cost-basis lookups, not silent defaults.

Aagman's deterministic SIR = white-box algo (logic disclosed + replicable) ⇒ exempt from SEBI Research-Analyst registration. Black-box (opaque/non-replicable) providers MUST register as RA + maintain a per-algo research report + re-register on any logic change. Preserve SIR determinism/disclosability to keep the exemption (SEBI circular SEBI/HO/MIRSD/MIRSD-PoD/P/CIR/2025/0000013, 4 Feb 2025; full applicability 1 Apr 2026).

Aagman holds SEBI RIA registration INA000021951 (Investment Adviser), NOT a Research Analyst registration. The shipped line 'Aagman is not a SEBI-registered research analyst' (PulseView.tsx:216) is accurate — frame RIA as enabling compliant distribution, not advice; the consumer product stays research/decision-support, not buy/sell calls.

Every order lifecycle event (place/modify/cancel/reject/fill) must produce an append-only audit row for SEBI compliance. Synonym event names in an if/elif dispatcher silently drop audit rows (4 live SimpleOrder rejects → 0 rows, PR #1527 #25). Canonical event vocabulary + flat-lookup dispatcher; SIR is append-only versioned for audit.

Do not surface unverifiable return/performance claims. Research/audit numbers must trace to a data artifact (report JSON / DB row / git commit), never to Claude's own prose or a prompt template — 'validated_params claimed WF 4/5 Sharpe 1.47' while saved reports showed gate1=false, test Sharpe ~0.83. If no source exists the claim is unverified — say so.

When citing F&O retail-loss context use the verified SEBI figures: 93% of F&O traders lost over FY22–FY24, ₹1.8 lakh crore aggregate (SEBI Sept 2024); ~1.13 crore unique individual F&O traders — NOT the stale '89% (2023)' or the '5 crore' figure that conflates demat accounts.
